selected_evidence.summary: Showed /tmp was not separately mounted (part of root xfs), /dev/shm was tmpfs without noexec, and no fstab entries existed for either, plus tmp.mount unit was disabled.

selected_evidence.requirement: fstab updated with noexec,nosuid,nodev for /tmp and /dev/shm
selected_evidence.summary: Backed up fstab and appended tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm with defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec, confirmed via cat /etc/fstab.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mounts applied live and options confirmed
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl daemon-reload plus mount/remount applied the new options immediately; findmnt showed both /tmp and /dev/shm with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec.

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof execution/setuid/device are ignored before reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Executable scripts placed in /tmp and /dev/shm failed with Permission denied (exit 126) due to noexec; test artifacts cleaned up.
Captured boot_id 98aa35f5-6905-42fd-9f07-0e28f75b4fa6 and confirmed mount options were healthy immediately before restart.
Backgrounded systemctl reboot with a short delay so the exec call returned successfully (reboot scheduled, pid=1628) before the node went down.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node unreachable during reboot, then proof of changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Polling showed the node still up briefly, then connection timeouts during the reboot window, then a successful reconnect with a new boot_id (662e94b4-e11c-440a-a86d-d699717075e9), proving an actual restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of hardened mounts
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, findmnt confirmed /tmp and /dev/shm still mounted with nosuid,nodev,noexec, and functional execution tests again failed with Permission denied, proving the hardening survived the restart.
